name: CryptoPay Card
summary: CryptoPay Card is one of the earliest Bitcoin debit cards in Europe, supporting 35+ cryptocurrencies. High €30,000 daily spending limit with straightforward €1/month fee structure.

kyc.notes: Requirements as published by the provider; confirm during onboarding.

faq.question: Does the CryptoPay Card charge a monthly fee?
faq.answer: Yes — it charges US$1 per month. Card issuance is US$5.

faq.question: What are the foreign-exchange fees on the CryptoPay Card?
faq.answer: It charges about 3% on non-base-currency spending.
